summary: ACCEPT. The converged Story 12.4 boundary is correct, fail-closed, architecture-aligned, and truthfully qualified. Exact Cross-Repository Resolution canonicalizes complete provider evidence before distinct-Document cardinality, persists decision-owned contributions while reusing only the tuple-unique REFERENCES Edge, rechecks live Repository authorization inside the transaction before v2 authority queries and again before commit, and preserves legacy rows without promotion. Endpoint-centered Flow Groups keep pair-specific execution identity separate from the cross-scan Business Logic Logical Document stable key; bounded planning refuses incomplete and over-limit groups. Retrieval requires a live server-owned Repository Access Scope, active lease and attempt identity, opaque handles, current Document Version/Source Anchor/revision/hash authority, durable reservation and admission revalidation, and content-dark refusal with zero result/provenance mutation. Strict streaming exposes only retrieve_code_logic and submit_business_logic, preserves exact tool-call history, enforces request/response, call, result, byte, inactivity and absolute bounds, and returns closed provider/submission categories without logging provider payloads or credentials. Publication independently reconstructs admitted evidence, exact decision/Edge and claim authority, serializes Version Chain updates under PostgreSQL locks, derives all-and-only GENERATED_FROM Edges, and atomically completes the job, Flow Group and execution while preserving prior successful Documents on partial failure. The plural authenticated API uses the established central mapping seam, ManagementAccess, ownership-filtered 404, Chinese ProblemDetails, and PostgreSQL as restart authority; no Story 12.5 UI, Chat, vector retrieval, or direct Pass 2 CodeGraph/JDT-LS path was introduced. Migration review found one cohesive additive v2 migration with modeled constraints, indexes, concurrency fields, legacy lifecycle coverage, clean rollback/reapply conditions, and no destructive ordinary-data backfill. Evidence quality is strong: 286/286 focused pure/hosted, 87/87 disposable PostgreSQL 17, 64/64 authenticated composition/API, 439/0/42 exact/Pass 2 regression, effective 442/0/1 adjacent regression after the 31/31 administrator sub-boundary, Web build with zero errors, and clean diff check. This review independently rebuilt and passed the newly added snake_case qualification contract 1/1 and reran the corrected extraction, authorization, retrieval, publication, streaming and Pass 1 handoff seams 397/397. The checked live artifact has 20/20 snake_case top-level fields; System, Repository, revision and Document identities are 64-character hashes; the provider value is reduced to https://opencode.ai; the database target contains no credential; and no API key, Authorization header, source root, source content, prompt transcript, raw candidate, or provider response appears. The live 1/1 provider call and retained-database graph were not repeated during this independent review; their sanitized artifact, 3m11s command record, one Published Flow Group, one Completed Pass 2 Job, one immutable Business Logic Document, three GENERATED_FROM Edges and three Source Anchors were verified against the converged evidence. One broader independent command selected 18 opt-in Pass 1 PostgreSQL cases without VULGATA_TEST_POSTGRES_ADMIN; each stopped at its explicit prerequisite before database contact, while the pinned administrator-qualified evidence remains 31/31. No Critical, High, Constitution MUST, privacy, migration, concurrency, architecture, or regression-blocking finding remains.
